enchantments.tooltip: Constitution +11: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Lifesealed +30: You are immune to magical effects that cause instant death. In addition, you have a +30% enhancement bonus to Negative Energy Absorption.
Vitality +36: Passive: +36 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +43 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
